transport_reason: Git CLI lacked authenticated transport. The connected GitHub Git Data API published the exact already-reviewed file tree under a new commit identity; original execution and review identities were not rewritten.
platform_status_scope: Previous blocked status is a historical observation; current explicit user authorization permits this push/PR/merge. Actual PR checks, merge, fresh-main CI and release are subsequent platform evidence.
added_files_scope: Only this transport reconciliation and exact original Git history; runtime source and tests unchanged.
limitations: Exact tree equality preserves content evidence; it does not forge identical commit metadata or predeclare remote CI/release success.
